dequantize_gemm: dequantize packed AWQ GEMM weights by unpacking, reversing order, and applying scales
unpack_awq: unpack packed AWQ qweight and qzeros tensors using bitwise right shift operations
reverse_awq_order: reverse the AWQ column ordering of unpacked weight and zero tensors
WQLinear_GEMM_from_linear: create a 4-bit AWQ quantized linear module from an existing PyTorch linear layer
WQLinearMMFunction_forward: run a quantized linear matrix multiplication using packed AWQ weights and scales
